notes: The production package is intentionally unsigned. The post-build verifier enforces complete NSIS/portable inventories, per-file ASAR integrity, the PE-embedded ASAR header digest, reviewed Electron fuses, dependency hashes, an absent Authenticode certificate table on the outer installer, explicit NotSigned status for both inner executables, and checksum-bound immutable staging. The existing root ob.js connector is packaged unchanged and verified byte-for-byte against the reviewed source checkout.
